raw_response:
Very weak liquidity (current ratio 0.34) and a highly leveraged balance sheet (liabilities are about 92% of assets; equity is only about 8% of assets) materially constrain credit quality. While the company remains profitable at the operating level, the combination of thin capitalization and poor near-term coverage is more consistent with a speculative-grade issuer in the lower BB/high B area.

DECISION: BB-
